ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

PageTitle.helper: Enter the page title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

PageLead.helper: Enter the page lead to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

BackgroundImage.helper: Recommended minimum: 1920 x 1080 px. Use a wide landscape image. Keep important content near the center-left, since the image may crop on different screen sizes.

PrimaryCtaButtonPage.helper: Enter the web address for primary button button page. You can use a page on this site or another website.

PrimaryCtaButtonFontAwesomeCss.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.
